architecture: Freeze authenticated V37 geometry and local model; train a zero-initialized confidence residual with the existing mixed loss and component-negative penalty, adding fixed 1.0 penalties for downward component-positive and upward family-negative residual shifts.
description: Fixed exploratory bidirectional preservation of synthetic component positives and family negatives alongside the existing real-positive and component-negative recipe; no sealed reads or production approval.
evaluation: Evaluate the single final checkpoint on fixed synthetic component and family development gates at threshold 0.1. No threshold search, checkpoint selection, sealed evaluation, production activation or release is authorized by this experiment.
limitations: The manual labels are imperfect, 481 labeled train centers were filtered before proposal selection, synthetic artifact-mask readiness is incomplete, and component-development and sealed-source overlap are unverified.
motivation: The prior preservation candidate reduced component-negative acceptance but suppressed component-positive train confidence and increased family-negative acceptance. Train-only evidence motivates a fixed directional hypothesis, not a proven improvement.
purpose: Explore fixed bidirectional confidence preservation using authenticated synthetic train features alongside authorized real positive proposals.
training_device: AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT gfx1032 via HIP cuda:0; CPU optimizer steps forbidden
training_inputs: Reuse 36,212 synthetic family rows and 2,171 authorized real positive proposals, 32,580 synthetic component negatives, 3,258 synthetic component positives, and 8,230 synthetic family negatives per authenticated view. Real unlabeled pixels are never assigned negative labels.
